$comment: The deck registry — one source of truth for what the index lists. Add a deck here and run ./build.sh; index.html is generated, never hand-edited. Anything derivable from the deck file itself (slide count, languages, title tag, build stamp) is NOT stored here — the generator reads it from the HTML so it can never drift.
